reviews.text:
I took my dog ​​Argo here for the first time for a week, and I'm very happy.
I received a video every day, and I always saw him happy and playing with other dogs. I highly recommend this center, five stars and more.
Thank you, and see you next time.
I brought my little mouse, and Massimiliano, the trainer, took masterful care of her. Highly recommended for the care and love he showed her.
We've brought our Milo here several times. We're very happy with it. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable. A place we recommend without hesitation.

We took our Milo to the kennel for a week. Federica, Chiara, and the rest of the staff immediately struck us as reliable, professional, and helpful. Two videos a day, therapy administered—all in all, everything was five-star. Our Milo is back to perfect health and as happy as ever. The price is advantageous even compared to other centers we had contacted. But that really wasn't the point; the only thing we really cared about was the dog's well-being. Well done, thank you. See you soon.

Exceptional facility and fantastic staff! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ I left my Shiba Inu at this dog training center for a whole month and it was a flawless experience. Anyone who knows the breed knows how independent, wary, and stubborn Shibas can be, but the staff did an extraordinary job. The dog was treated wonderfully, with touching attention and care. When I went to pick her up, I found her so sweet, calm, and incredibly obedient and good. You can tell she's spent a month surrounded by love, professionalism, and expertise. I recommend this center to anyone looking for a 100% safe and reliable place for their four-legged companion. Thank you so much for everything you've done!

We left Lola, our black Labrador, at the Saxarubra Dog Center for over twenty days: it was the first time we'd left my dog ​​for so long. We're truly, truly satisfied! ❤️
As always, Lola was treated like a family dog, with love, attention, care, and tons of cuddles. She had a blast, reunited with her friends, and for her, the Saxarubra Dog Center is always synonymous with fun, relaxation, and above all, a place where she knows she's loved and cared for.

Thank you so much to all the staff for taking such good care of our Lola. 🐾❤️ Highly recommended!

Highly recommended!!!
Empathy, professionalism, and love for dogs!!!
I took my little dog for lessons because walks were impossible (he pulled on the leash and wanted to attack all the dogs).
Result after just 3 lessons with Federica: he's much more disciplined on the leash and has a lot of fun running and playing with the other dogs when I take him to dog daycare at the center.
Highly recommended, both for training and for dog daycare.
Thank you so much 🥰🙏 …

My cat Camillo spent his vacation at the center, and I have to say I'm very satisfied. They updated us every day with photos and videos, and we saw him socializing with the other guests, especially with Eva, the cat, whom I think he misses a little now. It was a positive experience that we will definitely repeat in the future. Thanks to all the staff, who were very kind and affectionate with Camillo.

We kenneled our golden Joy and had a great time! The staff were all incredibly kind and knowledgeable. They sent us photos and videos every day... truly an excellent service, and Joy went home happy! Thank you so much.

Saxa Rubra Dog Center is a true guarantee! Federica and her team combine extraordinary expertise with unparalleled kindness and empathy, treating each dog with love and profound respect.
The best proof? My Golden Retriever, VIOLETTE, is always thrilled to return to them and can't wait to walk through the door. A peaceful, safe, and stimulating environment: highly recommended!

Super-qualified and wonderful staff
Our dogs consider it their second home
❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️
The staff is impeccable! So much love and passion for animals! Thank you so much, you are wonderful people, I highly recommend it to everyone for the loving care they have for our little animals 😾🐶🐕🤩
Gipsy, our almost 12-year-old Jack Russell, is always happy! It's great that they send us videos every day: it makes us feel less distant! Highly recommended.

We left our Rudy for 6 days and had a great time! The staff is professional, kind, and helpful! They send several videos and photos every day, which is much appreciated! We definitely recommend this place for a worry-free dog walk!
Super professional and helpful! If I could, I'd give 10 stars! A round of applause to all the staff ❤️

Our dog had a great time, interacting with the other dogs, even though she wasn't used to playing in dog parks, and Federica was very kind and helpful, meeting all our needs. We will definitely try this experience again!
Amazing experience, Scott is getting really good ☺️ and the staff is wonderful! I recommend it ❤️

Excellent kennel in the area, the dogs are happy, and that's what matters. Thanks to them, I no longer worry about leaving them somewhere if I have to go on a trip.
A big thank you to all the staff, who are always friendly and helpful!

I took my cat to this center for a week and was truly thrilled with the welcome and the services they offer. My cat is diabetic and therefore required two daily insulin injections and specific food. They sent me photos and videos every day, and Lyse was pampered more than at home! The girls clearly care about animals. Simply wonderful.
Thank you so much 🙏🩵 …

A wonderful experience for our little dog. Despite my initial concerns about leaving him for ten days, they immediately put my mind at ease. I received daily updates via photos and videos, and our furry friend returned home happy and healthy! We'll definitely be back ❣️
I took my 4-year-old Labrador Oliver to this dog training center and loved it. Recommended.

Fabulous facility, completely surrounded by large green spaces, where all the dogs run happily. This is evident from the videos we receive daily. The dog handlers are incredibly sweet with our treasures, and honestly, I don't think you could ask for more!

Blue is so happy when we go to school!
A beautiful place with lots of space to play and learn! Special thanks to Stella, who is extremely capable and patient and is helping me manage my dog's extreme vivacity!
The best nursery ever in Rome 🙏🏻❤️🐶 …
Fantastic experience. My dog ​​has a blast (I can see it from the videos they send me from the center), and they are attentive, caring, and super kind. Highly recommended.

My experience at this dog training center was incredibly positive! We attended basic training classes with our puppy Quark and also took advantage of the daycare service.
The trainer, Federica, was truly invaluable and always available: she guided both us and our puppy with skill and patience. We learned so many useful things and, above all, Quark had a blast!
The dog training center is a safe and pleasant place for him. Therefore, when we need someone to take care of him, we feel comfortable entrusting him to Federica and her team, especially because we receive video updates throughout the day.
I absolutely recommend it!!!

Federica is a truly exceptional dog trainer. From our first meeting, she demonstrated great expertise, sensitivity, and passion for her work. She managed to establish a special relationship with both my dog ​​and me, explaining each step clearly and patiently.

Thank you ❤️

I left my puppy at this boarding house and couldn't be more satisfied. From the first contact, I found the staff kind, helpful, and above all very passionate. During my stay, I received photos and updates, which made me feel at ease and at peace.
I highly recommend it!!
Thank you 🤩 …

I left my three Chihuahuas at this center for the first time, and they immediately put me at ease. I really appreciated the photo monitoring, which is very reassuring. They are attentive not only to the animals, but also to their owners, understanding the anxiety of leaving them alone.
Kind, helpful, and professional. Thank you, Barbara.

Here at the dog training center, we immediately felt safe and in good hands with Tania, who has always been kind and helpful! Our Rocket has a very strong temperament. He was a serial leash puller, and he didn't have any basic commands to keep him balanced in an urban environment; he would take off at the slightest distraction. Now he pays close attention to us and our sounds, has excellent behavior, knows all the basic commands, and stays focused on us. He's changed so much since we started this program; he's finally become a manageable dog, whereas before he was a wild, unstoppable dog and we were losing hope.
Rocket is beloved by everyone at the center and is always super happy to return to his teacher Tania, his furry friends, and all the girls who work there, who love him to bits!! ❤️

The dog training center, and Tania in particular, guided us step by step even before Lumi's arrival, helping us prepare as best as possible. The training is truly effective: Lumi responds very well both on walks and when called. We were a bit worried about the energy of an Australian Shepherd, but thanks to their advice, we found strategies to keep her happy and balanced.

Dog daycare has become a true lifesaver: Lumi goes there enthusiastically, socializes with other dogs, and is pampered like a princess, with photos and videos that reassure us every time. An excellent experience in every way.

If I could give it a sixth star, it would be perfect.

Thyra was taken in from a shelter because she was phobic/fearful and wouldn't listen to anything or anyone—a free spirit! But thanks to the Saxa Rubra Dog Training Center (we are cared for by Tania), in just over a month they gave me and my dog ​​the opportunity to bond in a way I never would have expected. Competence and professionalism come first, then we should add flexibility, simplicity, fairness, and kindness. Today, my best friend and I are bonded and empathetic, we travel the world safely and happily. The journey has only just begun, but the results, thanks also to perseverance, have already begun to blossom. Thank you, Saxa Rubra Dog Training Center, and thank you, Tania, along with the entire great team that makes up this incredible center.

I finally found a dog training center where I can take Brinkley with complete peace of mind. He's having so much fun at daycare! And he's also happy when I leave him overnight. The girls are all great and pamper him so much! 😄
But above all, Tania and Sofia are special! We entrusted them with a training program with Brinkley, who is already almost 9 years old. Despite this, I see great progress, and he learns and has fun in class! Thank you so much! ❤️
Thank you 🍀💚🩷 …

A wonderful place, me and my 5-year-old puppy Kuzco (he's happier to be going than I am!)
I went to this center recommended by friends of friends because Kuzco and I will be moving to another home and to manage his reactive condition.
Although we've only had 6 lessons so far (and he's already an adult), the improvements have been visible from day one.
The entire staff pays special attention to the well-being of the furry ones, and they are always available and empathetic towards us owners (which is not a given). They're true professionals!
Thanks to Tania and the entire staff!
Mattia and Kuzco :)

I took my 7-month-old dachshund to this dog training center and loved it. We had lessons with Tania, we had a great time; you can immediately see how much she loves her job and she's really good at it. She perfectly understood where and how we needed to work, and in a short time I saw huge improvements in my puppy's behavior. It was a wonderful experience for me and especially for my dachshund, who had a blast!

We are completely satisfied with the Saxa Rubra dog training center. We thank our wonderful teacher Tania and all the staff at the center for their professionalism and kindness.
Having an adopted adult dog with a history of abuse that made him a bit of a tripod and very reactive because he had to defend himself from everything and everyone day and night while tied to a chain, the training and the results we are achieving are immense. We thank Tanja and for us it is a joy to come to the center and see our puppy happy and proactive about training. Thanks to all the staff, highly recommended 👍

The training program I'm doing with Stella at the Saxa Rubra Dog Training Center is simply extraordinary.

Stella has improved dramatically in every aspect: her recall has become reliable, her leash walking is finally calm and enjoyable, and her free walking in the park is a moment of freedom experienced with balance and attention. We've also made enormous progress indoors, especially thanks to the introduction of the crate, suggested and explained with great professionalism by our fantastic trainer Tania.

This program has truly changed our world. Stella is overjoyed every time we go to class: she wags her tail as soon as she understands where we're going! And I, who accompany her and actively participate in the lessons, also experience every session as a moment of growth, complicity, and great satisfaction.

Tania works with love, dedication, expertise, and a contagious kindness that makes every day special. It's not just training: it's building relationships, trust, and harmony.

Thank you so much to the Saxa Rubra Dog Training Center. Thank you, Tania, for making this journey so precious for me and Stella. 🐶💛

I took my Ariel to this boarding house for 5 days (I'd never been away from her for so many days). The girls were impeccable, they made me feel at ease day after day. They sent videos morning and afternoon, and messages for every occasion... always seeing her happy playing with them. The videos show that they treated her like she was their own (Ariel), giving her love, time, and attention. They also offer grooming services. I will definitely bring her back as soon as I need it, thank you so much. 💖

I can't thank Tania enough for the work she did with Laika. Walking my dog ​​had become very tiring. Even though she's incredibly sweet, she was unmanageable on the leash and didn't seem to hear me at all. I feared that at 5 years old it was too late to change certain behaviors, but Tania immediately understood how to approach her. In a short time, she transformed our walks into a peaceful experience, increasingly building a healthy relationship with my little Laika. This center is a precious reference point! Thank you, Tania.
Recommended 🐾

Fantastic experience!!! I left my three dogs (a bulldog and two Chihuahuas) at the center for three days and they were pampered, spoiled, and cared for in a truly wonderful way. They're always happy to send videos of their furry friends to reassure their owners. I'd already taken them to daycare and had a great experience, but the boarding service was truly unique. I recommend it to everyone.

I adopted Ares from the shelter when he was just 1 month old, carrying with him the scars of abandonment and a strong tendency toward potential aggression. Today Ares is 6 months old. We were struggling until we met Tania.
Tania is a fantastic trainer, but to call her just that would be an understatement. In just a few lessons, we not only resolved Ares's aggression issues, but something deeper happened: thanks to her, I changed. Tania taught me to read my dog's signals, to truly understand him, and to communicate with him appropriately.
Today, Ares and I have established a wonderful relationship, based on trust and mutual understanding. We happily continue our training journey, which began about 2 months ago, knowing we are in expert, human hands. If you're looking for someone who doesn't just "train" your dog, but who builds a bond between you and your four-legged companion, this is the right place.
Highly recommended! 🐾

A fantastic experience for our Maggie, who is elderly and blind. The staff was super attentive to her needs. Every day I received videos showing her calm and comfortable. She stayed for 6 nights. We will definitely come back and highly recommend the facility.

SV Luxury Dog is an excellent dog training center. My Labradors go there happily and return happy. The environment is well-maintained, safe, and the dogs are treated as individuals, not numbers. The staff is competent, reliable, and truly passionate. Highly recommended for anyone who cares ❤️ about their dog. 🐾💙 …
Professional staff. The girls have a gift for quickly becoming familiar with dogs.

The Saxa Rubra dog training center has become like a second home for our dog Rumba. We initially discovered the center for boarding, and from the first time we went, we felt comfortable and knew our dog would be in excellent hands. This was almost two years ago, and since then, whenever we go somewhere where we can't take her, we bring her here for boarding, where she is treated very well, plays, and has fun.

Subsequently, about two months ago, we also started training with Tania (THE BEST!), since Rumba is a very territorial Belgian Shepherd-like dog. After just two months, Rumba now listens to our commands much more, and we are able to control her much better.

Thank you so much for the extraordinary work you do.

Rumba and Family

I took my pitbull puppy to the Saxa Rubra dog training center, and I'm delighted with my choice. The trainer, Tania, is loving yet rigorous with Lola, who is thrilled to teach.
I saw results immediately; Lola is well-behaved and playful, and she's making steady progress.
The center is surrounded by greenery, and besides being beneficial for the dogs, it's also helpful for the owners, who get to know their puppies better.

Luffy is thrilled to be attending daycare at this center... He's having fun, he's happy in the evenings, and above all, being around other well-balanced dogs improves his ability to communicate and understand other dogs' signals. Highly recommended, especially for the staff and the frequent videos and updates on Luffy's day!
Thank you so much🍀❤️ …

I couldn't be more satisfied with the care I received from Federica and the Saxa Rubra Dog Training Center throughout the summer. Entrusting my dog ​​and her five puppies to them was a huge responsibility and a task that required exceptional care and dedication, and Federica exceeded every expectation.
She and her wonderful staff handled the situation impeccably, demonstrating not only great professionalism and expertise in caring for dogs of all ages, but also a deep passion. I was constantly updated on their growth, and from every photo and video I received daily, I could see the love and care dedicated to each individual puppy and their mother. The facility is clean, safe, and welcoming—the ideal environment for raising puppies.
If you're looking for high-quality boarding or training services with professionalism, expertise, and a big heart, I absolutely recommend it.

I had a wonderful time at the Saxa Rubra dog training center! Federica is truly reliable, extremely kind and courteous, a true professional. Her approach to animals and people is unique, and I must say, she's simply irreplaceable. I highly recommend Saxa Rubra to anyone looking for a reliable and welcoming dog training center!

I've been taking my dog ​​to their doggie daycare for a few days now, and I'm amazed at how happy my little one is.
Thank you so much!

When you think you have no hope, the universe sends you Tania, who, at this super center, is so kind and professional, she lovingly revolutionized my dog ​​Artù's aggressive behavior. A 5-year-old Maremma mix who used to attack out of fear... now, after 5 lessons, he walks on heel, listens to every command, and above all, Tania has lifted a weight off my heart. Now I go for walks serenely and happily with a soft leash, dodging every fear of the great Artù with commands.
Just a word of warning: if you're jealous, be prepared to share; your dog will love Tania madly :)

We brought our 4-month-old dog Nala to the training center because she was afraid and didn't want to leave the house. Luckily, we met the trainer, Tania, who is extremely competent, reliable, and passionate about her job. Immediately after the introductory meeting, Nala had already gained more confidence and had overcome her fear of walking through the door.

We've been training for two months now, and every day we see only improvements.

I recommend the center to anyone with any type of problem your dog may have, because Tania solves them all!

We chose to bring Otto, our 3-month-old Lagotto Romagnolo puppy, to the Saxa Rubra dog training center, and after just a few weeks of lessons (he's now 3 and a half months old), we can say we've found a truly valuable mentor. We take lessons with Tania, an extraordinary professional, capable not only of imparting top-notch technical skills but also of guiding us, the owners, with patience, helpfulness, and a great deal of humanity. Every piece of advice we've received from Tania has been invaluable: she's helped us correct small behaviors, establish a balanced education, and above all, help us grow alongside our puppy, respecting his pace and needs. It's amazing to see our dog's progress week after week, and the serenity we experience during the lessons is truly unique. The Saxa Rubra center stands out for its professionalism, organization, and attention to the needs of dogs and their families. You can sense a great passion for her work and a genuine concern for the animals' well-being, aspects that truly make a difference.
Another very positive note is that the center is open 7 days a week and also offers dog daycare and boarding, a truly convenient and useful service that allows you to entrust your four-legged friends to expert hands with complete peace of mind.
We highly recommend the Saxa Rubra dog training center to anyone wishing to embark on a training program with their dog: here you will find not only a place for training, but also a peaceful environment where you can build a relationship of trust and harmony with your four-legged companion.

I brought my hyperactive dog with me. Due to commitments, I needed to spend hours indoors, so I preferred to give my dog ​​some space to relax. She hates sleeping and staying indoors, but she's very energetic. I usually don't trust kennels, but by following them on social media, I saw that they have excellent methods for grouping dogs, especially those with dogs, and that they're very professional in general.
So I decided to try them. In the end, I left my dog ​​alone for several days! Thank you so much, the results were excellent, and she was always eager to return to the center ☺️☺️

Extremely kind, attentive, and reliable! Luigi had a wonderful time, and we'll definitely take him again!
They kept me updated with photos and videos showing how well he was doing and how calm he was! Thank you again for everything!

My Cane Corso dog and I have been coming here for 7 months now, both for training and for daycare and boarding.
What can I say? We were truly fortunate to have Tania as our trainer. She's extremely competent, helpful, and passionate about her job. I would recommend her to anyone, always!
It was a great joy for my dog, too, who now considers her a second mother, a role model.
The facility is very large and surrounded by greenery, with plenty of space for our furry friends to play. I absolutely recommend a tour of the facility, especially to anyone who's thinking of starting a training program for their four-legged friend. I hope you find our beloved Tania!
Some photos of my dog ​​at the center 🩷
Thanks to everyone from me and Maze

I've been taking my Kyra, a pitbull she got from the shelter, to the dog training center for months. We were fortunate to have met Tania, our trainer, who is loving and, above all, very knowledgeable and competent, as are all the others. My little girl loves going to the center. I recommend it 100%.

This was the second time I've left my puppy, and I have to say I was very happy with how they handled and pampered her.
Thanks to Federica and her staff.

Great experience, I left my French bulldog Vittorio for 10 days with my parents' two dogs, and I had a great time. The facility has large green spaces and the staff also keeps you updated by sending you videos and photos of your puppies!! Now that I've found you, I have a safe place to leave my big dog!! ❤️

I entrusted Federica and her staff with my dachshund for 15 days. I've never found such a welcoming and well-prepared center. Their kindness and skill made my dog ​​feel at home. They were also excellent at keeping me updated with videos and photos.
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!!
Highly recommended center, helpful, professional, and kind. Excellent

I've been using this dog training center for almost two years now, and I can confidently say I've found a valuable resource. My cat is on medication, and the staff has always been impeccable in ensuring punctuality and precision in administering her medications, giving me complete peace of mind and security.

Whenever I've needed time off for vacation or simply to take a break, I've been able to count on their essential support. The staff is dedicated, passionate, and attentive, characteristics that are reflected in the way they care for the animals, treating them with respect and sensitivity.

I would recommend, and already am, this facility to anyone who needs to leave their dog in safe and loving hands. I visited the Center a few months ago because I was looking for a boarding facility for our poodle, who was still a puppy, and whom I knew we would have to leave in August for 11 days, a fairly long stay. The reviews I'd read had definitely encouraged me, but seeing him with my own eyes and speaking with the staff convinced me even more to give it a try. So I started bringing Teo twice a week, just for a few hours, and then leaving him first for one, then two, then four nights. To see his reactions and to decide if it was the right place. I must say I was thrilled with the organization of the place (each dog has its own personal resting space; the larger dogs sleep in a separate section from the smaller ones; there are several large walk areas, and they are equipped to handle heat, cold, and rain) but above all with the attention, passion, and care that the entire young and well-trained staff devotes to each dog entrusted to them. Federica, the center's manager, responds immediately to every question, concern, or request, always kind and helpful. All of these elements helped me overcome the fear and guilt of leaving an 8-month-old puppy for what seemed like an incredibly long time. We picked up Teo yesterday. Every day during his stay, we received videos showing how, from a slightly shy start, Teo felt increasingly at ease, calm, cheerful, and playful. We picked him up yesterday. He was certainly happy to see us again, but we found him calm and healthy, without any signs of stress. I thank Federica, all the wonderful girls, and Andrea (who I'm told is one of her "favorites" 😊) for the love with which they looked after Teo and with which they look after every single dog. We'll definitely be back!
Gorgeous and super attentive girls!

Simply perfect!
We brought our two Maltipo dogs and left them there twice for about 10 days, something we'd never done before because we were worried about leaving them alone!
The dogs integrated very well; they ran and played in a green area with many other dogs of all breeds without any problems!
Every day I received videos of what they were doing; at night they sleep in comfortable kennels without cages.
The staff was super kind and available to answer all our questions; they've become our go-to!
Thank you so much and congratulations on the organization and the location!
Highly recommended!!!!

Federica and her staff are excellent. This is the second time we've brought Oliver, he's very happy with it, and they keep us updated daily with videos and photos. I highly recommend them if you want a relaxing holiday knowing your four-legged friend is in good hands 😊😊😊 …

I left Minnie, my poodle, for the first time with Federica and her staff and she had a great time... she came back happy. I'm happy to have found this center where I'll go for training and I will definitely leave her again with a light heart... thanks to everyone

I often turn to this dog training center when I need someone to care for Lola, my 1-year-old Labrador. I don't just turn to Federica and the entire staff because I need to leave Lola in trustworthy, professional hands, but above all, I do it as a gift to my dog, who, as soon as she realizes she'll be spending some time there, starts wagging her tail and jumping for joy!

I wanted to compliment the entire team
at the dog training center because they are very professional, and the environment is very well-maintained. I recommend it for both short and long-term stays.

Congratulations

Thank you
Agostino
Fantastic experience, my Nala goes very willingly, the staff is welcoming and attentive

We will always strive to give more.
Your reviews are a great source of inspiration and pride for us.

We left our dog for 8 nights and 9 days and had a great time.
Constant daily video updates show the dogs playing on the lawn, cleaning, and the possibility of a bath before returning them (which we had obviously already requested).
The dog was picked up already bathed and in excellent physical and behavioral condition.
I strongly recommend making the location much more visible (with signs and/or other signage) because, even with a GPS, once you get close, you can get a bit lost before you find it. FT

I've known the dog training center for a year. Every time I bring my 4-year-old Tito, he doesn't want to leave... he's slept there for up to two weeks and has been pampered by the staff, but especially by the center's management... it's a wonderful center and I recommend it to everyone.

I'd like to share my thoughts: it's difficult to leave your dog in the hands of strangers. I trusted them, and I'll do it a thousand times over...

Thanks to the management of the SAXA RUBRA DOG CENTER...

Exclusive, clean center, with highly skilled and patient staff.
Thank you all for the peaceful days you gave me, while you were so thoughtful about my beloved puppy.
Thank you.
Magnificent, we had a great time, the staff was exquisite.

A wonderfully managed dog training center. The space is large and the staff is knowledgeable. I left my dog ​​overnight, and the staff send photos and videos of their dogs, so I can feel less lost and see that they're doing well. ❤️
If I ever need to again, I'll come back. Thanks again.

Excellent center, competent, professional staff, available to answer any questions, spacious stalls, exceptionally clean,
work done with passion and love, highly recommended. Thanks again for your help, Saverio and Bella (Springer/Setter mix)
The owner is fantastic

Excellent welcome, we stopped by for information on dog boarding and training for our husky, we were welcomed even without an appointment, happy with the very innovative structure and we immediately purchased the training package with immediate availability, very reasonable prices, to say the least, we were surprised, we recommend it to everyone

Truly an excellent experience! It was the first time I took my 6-year-old pointer to this dog training center, and we were thrilled. A place where professionalism and love for animals are immediately apparent. Complete service: boarding, playtime, training, and lots of cuddles. My dog ​​was welcomed and cared for with care and affection. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a safe and peaceful place for their four-legged friend! Thank you!!!! 🌸🐶

We arrived at this dog training center and found the staff knowledgeable, the green space perfect for our furry friends, and the care and attention they paid to the dogs was impeccable!
Highly recommended!
I visited the center and found it to be truly excellent! Clean, well-kept, and with excellent staff. Well done!!!

Professional, organized, and very kind.
Our big puppy came home relaxed and happy.
Thank you

I took Baloo to this beautiful center for two days.
Large green spaces where he can run and play.
A special thanks to Federica and all the staff, who were kind, competent, and incredibly sweet with all the dogs.
For a first experience, it couldn't have been better... a truly fantastic center. Baloo thanks you and can't wait to come back.

A very positive experience. After five days of boarding, my dog ​​was calm. Tired, obviously, but absolutely not stressed.

Another thing I've experienced with other boarding facilities: the dog didn't have a bad odor, or even worse, he didn't smell like something they'd put on him to cover it up.
A clear sign of excellent cleanliness in the kennels.

The trainers are polite, kind, and care about the animals. It shows.

Very good. Keep up the good work.

The most beautiful place in the world!!!! My two furry children, Achille and Bianca, tell me this every day. They can't wait to arrive at the Saxa Rubra Dog Center every day, where they are welcomed by highly qualified trainers. The best in terms of both the nursery, the boarding, and the training. My heartfelt thanks.

Since my dog ​​Milo has been attending their daycare, he's changed so much! He's happier, more energetic, and lets off steam in healthy ways by playing with other dogs. It's wonderful to see him so enthusiastic and calm when I drop him off in the morning. The girls are all very welcoming and kind. They always keep me updated on how Milo is doing. I wanted to thank them for the care and attention they give him every day; it's clear how much love and dedication they give him!
